measured: The Volter launch World uses Hacker News's site as a signed-in person: login, submit, comment, reply, vote, logout and listings at news.ycombinator.com. The model-editor campaign is sourced from volter-ai/media launch/dry-run f6a2a0816e53: gtm/channels.yaml:88 names a Show HN through its submit form by hand, channel hn-aaron/account yuerany. Its sender files contain no Hacker News sender; no scanned application calls the public read API. The owner's launch-scope ruling also includes switching accounts and checking the upvote; the campaign does not solicit upvotes. The site and read API share stored state, so the launch reviewer reads items and newstories. Those read operations are reached by the life and published examples, not an application call; jobstories remains the gap. The channel asks the person to read Hacker News's own Show HN rules: the show page links to the real rules page rather than republishing it.
